intent.user: A person running this local example
intent.problem: Collect valid web URLs without repeated entries
intent.outcome: Add a valid URL and receive one list entry

sources.reference: README.md — synthetic scenario, not user research
sources.statement: The local user wants to collect web URLs once.

requirements.statement: Accept HTTP and HTTPS URLs with a host. Reject empty input, embedded credentials, internal whitespace or control characters, and malformed or out-of-range ports.

criteria.statement: Adding a valid URL with surrounding spaces returns one trimmed URL.
An empty URL, unsupported scheme, missing host, embedded credentials, internal whitespace or control characters, or malformed or out-of-range port raises a validation error.

requirements.statement: Repeated additions of the same trimmed URL are idempotent.

criteria.statement: Adding the same URL twice leaves exactly one list entry.

assumptions.statement: Exact trimmed string equality is enough for duplicate detection in this example.
assumptions.basis: Explicit teaching scope; URL canonicalization is excluded.

tasks.title: Implement URL validation and idempotent addition

checks.procedure: Run the local command with duplicate valid URLs and then invalid input. Record actual results. No deployment is included.
Inspect network and persistence behavior and confirm recovery from invalid input. Record actual results.
Observe a person complete the local task. Record the actual observation and limits; leave open if no person participated.
